title: The batch runner's local checks call the same entry point as CI
why: Batch 36 went red on CI: the local pre-batch checks lacked lint/check_comment_narration.py, which CI's code-check job runs (two narrating comments from #1321).
note: Coordinator 15:18 CST Nov 6. Skill ci-hygiene step 8 does not list that check. Fix the cause: the batch runner's local run calls the CI job's own entry point (bin/ci-job checks, or its equal), so no list can drift. Do not add one more name to a list.
